_about: Hero skill effects (user's choice: every skill its own effect). Skill id -> cast effect recipe in src/systems/skillFx.js (CAST_MS). A rotation spell is named 'skillId:SHORT'. Skills not listed here keep the plain coloured ring. Projectiles (knife, rain, note, fireball, darkbolt, holybolt, flask) are drawn per projectile event (SHOT_MS); lightning comes from itemFx.js.
